title: America's Air Show 2025 B-Roll Day 1: F-35B Lightning Il
description: A U.S. Marine Corps F-35B Lightning Il assigned to Marine Fighter Attack Training Squadron (VMFAT) 502, Marine Aircraft Group 11, 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing, conducts an aerial demonstration of its vertical landing and short take off capabilities during the 2025 Marine Corps Air Station Miramar Airshow in San Diego, Sept. 26, 2025. The F-35B Lightning Il are flown by aviators with Marine Fighter Attack Training Squadron 502 and is designed to operate from austere bases, along with a range of aviation-capable ships with its short take off and vertical landing capability. America's Air Show 2025 is a unique and incredible opportunity to witness Marine and joint aviation capabilities, civilian performers, and the world-famous Blue Angels; to celebrate the 250th birthday of the Marine Corps alongside Marines, and to see first-hand the innovative spirit of the Marine Corps through emerging technologies and forward-thinking. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Vivian Martinez-Reyes)
